item.description:
Koegaki 1.2.3

  • The microphone connection heals itself. If your input device resets, disconnects, or the macOS audio system drops it mid-session (as recent macOS 27 builds sometimes do), Koegaki now notices and reconnects on its own instead of failing until you toggle inputs or relaunch.
  • Capture problems now say which microphone they are about, and a repeated one tells you the way out.
  • A small log on your Mac records microphone trouble so problems can be diagnosed after the fact. It never leaves your machine.
